evidence: The requested scratch Transformer implementation does not exist yet; no runtime or syntax success is claimed.
The repository provides fixed 2000-pair training and 300-pair validation JSONL manifests.
common_io.py enforces RGB float32 [0,1], paired shapes, quality status, and safe output paths.
rfn.jsonl contains exactly 66976 train/pass records but also contains val and test records, so it cannot be passed unchanged to loaders that require one split per manifest.
Existing SD3.5 B0/B1/B2 code freezes the pretrained Transformer and trains a ControlNet.
The new decision requires no ControlNet, a randomly initialized SD3.5 Transformer, and an explicit spatial blur-latent condition path.
No new scratch configuration, checkpoint contract, dependency lock, or prompt-embedding cache exists yet.
The local Python environment does not currently contain diffusers, so the proposed model cannot be instantiated locally.
The root evaluate.py requires exactly 300 aligned PNG outputs and computes full-image RGB PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS-Alex without resize or crop.
New inference code can save through common_io.save_prediction and reuse evaluate.py unchanged.
The fixed debug manifests were previously checked for exact sample, path, and group overlap.
Full-data training must filter only the existing rfn train split and keep fixed debug_val for evaluation.

findings.message: Existing ControlNet code must not be presented as the requested scratch Transformer implementation.
A trainable spatial conditioning stem and a custom conditional Flow Matching sampler must be implemented before training.
Full random initialization of the roughly 4.94 GB BF16 Transformer weight file is substantially more memory intensive than the prior ControlNet runs.
